# Add-ons

A slot is one decision about the stack: the database, the ORM, auth, and so on. Each add-on is one choice in one slot. Most slots take one choice or none; Extras takes any number. Pick them when you create a project, or add them later with `npx create-efforge add <slot>/<option>`. Every page has the same headings: What it is for, Add it, Needs, Conflicts with, Service and layer, Files it writes, Files it edits, Dependencies, Environment variables, Package scripts, Rules it adds to AGENTS.md, Limits.

`npx create-efforge list` prints the same list, and `list --json` prints it as JSON.

## Runtime (`runtime`)

- [Cloudflare Workers](runtime-cloudflare.md) (`runtime/cloudflare`): Runs the app on Cloudflare Workers via @cloudflare/vite-plugin.

## Database (`database`)

- [Cloudflare D1](database-d1.md) (`database/d1`): A D1 binding (SQLite on Cloudflare) and the `@repo/db` package.
- [Postgres](database-postgres.md) (`database/postgres`): Postgres reached through a Hyperdrive binding on Workers, with a local docker-compose database and the `@repo/db` package.

## ORM (`orm`)

- [Drizzle ORM](orm-drizzle.md) (`orm/drizzle`): Drizzle 1.0 with its Effect drivers behind the Database service; migrations come from drizzle-kit.
- [Effect SQL](orm-effect-sql.md) (`orm/effect-sql`): Plain Effect SQL (tagged-template queries) behind the Database service; migrations are SQL files.

## Auth (`auth`)

- [Better Auth](auth-better-auth.md) (`auth/better-auth`): Email and password sign-in with Better Auth, a guarded /app and a user menu.
- [Better Auth with organizations](auth-better-auth-orgs.md) (`auth/better-auth-orgs`): Email and password sign-in with Better Auth, plus organizations: an org switcher, member management and invite links.

## Infrastructure as code (`infra`)

- [Alchemy](infra-alchemy.md) (`infra/alchemy`): Infrastructure as Effects (Alchemy v2): infra/alchemy.run.ts declares the Worker and its bindings instead of wrangler.jsonc, with PR preview stages deployed from GitHub Actions.

## AI (`ai`)

- [Effect AI (bring your own key)](ai-effect-ai-byok.md) (`ai/effect-ai-byok`): An Llm service on Effect AI with Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter and Ollama providers; keys come from the environment, or are saved encrypted per organization when auth has organizations.

## Extras (`extras`)

- [Browser](extras-browser.md) (`extras/browser`): A headless browser: a Browser service on a Cloudflare Container that runs Playwright (apps/browser).
- [Email](extras-email.md) (`extras/email`): Transactional email: a Mailer service on Cloudflare Email Service, printed to the console in development, plus invitation emails with organizations.
- [Realtime](extras-realtime.md) (`extras/realtime`): WebSockets: a Realtime service, a hibernating Room Durable Object, a useRoom hook and a dashboard card.
- [Storage](extras-storage.md) (`extras/storage`): Object storage: a Storage service on R2 with Worker-served signed download URLs.
- [Workflows](extras-workflows.md) (`extras/workflows`): Durable background jobs: a Jobs service on Cloudflare Workflows, with an example workflow and server functions.
